title: "Everything Spice" Baked Salmon Rice Bowl with Avocado & Tomatoes

instructions.instruction: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. ½ cup jasmine rice 1 cup water
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. 1 pint grape tomatoes lemon ½ small bunch fresh dill ½ avocado

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, transfer tomatoes to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. 2 tsp extra virgin olive oil ¼ tsp salt
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are just beginning to burst, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture. 2 tsp sesame seeds 1 tsp poppy seeds ¼ tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp onion powder ¼ tsp black pepper

Pat the salmon dry with paper towels, season with salt, and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Spread the top-side with Dijon, then sprinkle evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.) ¾ lb salmon fillet ¼ tsp salt 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
When the tomatoes are starting to burst, remove from the oven. Add salmon to the baking sheet, nestling the fillets into the tomatoes.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the tomatoes are browned and salmon is cooked through, 7-8 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl.

Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside. 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil ⅛ tsp salt ⅛ tsp black pepper
Halve and pit avocado. Halve lengthwise and slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with salmon, roasted tomatoes, avocado, and capers, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy! 1 tbsp capers
